text.hi: बीते समय में जो काम चल रहा था, उसके लिए was/were + ing: Two boys were playing (दो लड़के खेल रहे थे)। जो काम हो गया, उसके लिए दूसरा रूप: They ran (वे दौड़े)।
text.hinglish: Beete samay mein jo kaam chal raha tha, uske liye was/were + ing: Two boys were playing (do ladke khel rahe the). Jo kaam ho gaya, uske liye doosra roop: They ran (woh daude).
text.en: For an action going on in the past, use was/were + ing: Two boys were playing. For a finished action, use the past form: They ran.

steps.sentence: Two boys ___ in the ground with a ball. (play)

meaning.hi: दो लड़के मैदान में गेंद से खेल रहे थे।
meaning.hinglish: Do ladke maidaan mein gend se khel rahe the.

meaning.hi: कुछ लड़के उन्हें देख रहे थे।
meaning.hinglish: Kuch ladke unhe dekh rahe the.

steps.sentence: All of them ___ their free time. (enjoy)

meaning.hi: वे सब अपने खाली समय का मज़ा ले रहे थे।
meaning.hinglish: Woh sab apne khaali samay ka mazaa le rahe the.

steps.sentence: Now all of them ___ back to their rooms. (run)

meaning.hi: अब वे सब दौड़कर अपने कमरों में चले गए।
meaning.hinglish: Ab woh sab daudkar apne kamron mein chale gaye.

steps.sentence: One of them ___ up the ball. (pick)

meaning.hi: उनमें से एक ने गेंद उठा ली।
meaning.hinglish: Unmein se ek ne gend utha li.

text.hi: अब जवाब से सवाल बनाओ। किताब का उदाहरण: Suman has her lunch at office. (where) → Where does Suman have her lunch?
text.hinglish: Ab jawab se sawaal banao. Kitaab ka udaharan: Suman has her lunch at office. (where) → Where does Suman have her lunch?
text.en: Now make questions from answers. The book's example: Suman has her lunch at office. (where) → Where does Suman have her lunch?

prompt.hi: जवाब: She has her lunch at 10 o'clock. (when)
prompt.hinglish: Jawab: She has her lunch at 10 o'clock. (when)
prompt.en: Answer: She has her lunch at 10 o'clock. Ask with ‘when’.

steps.answer: When does she have her lunch?

meaning.hi: वह दोपहर का खाना कब खाती है?
meaning.hinglish: Woh dopahar ka khaana kab khaati hai?

prompt.hi: जवाब: She has chappaties and vegetables for lunch. (what)
prompt.hinglish: Jawab: She has chappaties and vegetables for lunch. (what)
prompt.en: Answer: She has chappaties and vegetables. Ask with ‘what’.

steps.answer: What does she have for lunch?

meaning.hi: वह दोपहर में क्या खाती है?
meaning.hinglish: Woh dopahar mein kya khaati hai?

prompt.hi: जवाब: She had dinner at her friend's home last night. (where)
prompt.hinglish: Jawab: She had dinner at her friend's home last night. (where)
prompt.en: Answer: She had dinner at her friend's home. Ask with ‘where’.

steps.answer: Where did she have dinner last night?

meaning.hi: कल रात उसने खाना कहाँ खाया?
meaning.hinglish: Kal raat usne khaana kahan khaaya?

text.hi: किताब का एक नोट: apostrophe (’)। एक के लिए ’s (the man's story), कई (s वाले) के लिए s’ (the merchants' story)।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka ek note: apostrophe (’). Ek ke liye ’s (the man's story), kai (s waale) ke liye s’ (the merchants' story).
text.en: A note from the book: the apostrophe. One person: ’s (the man's story). More than one, ending in s: s’ (the merchants' story).

steps.question: The story of the two merchants is ...
